title: Sum positive values
prompt: Return the sum of values greater than zero in a list. Return 0 for an empty list.

title: Count vowels
prompt: Count a, e, i, o, and u in a string, ignoring case. Other characters do not count.

title: Keep first occurrences
prompt: Return a new list containing each integer only once, preserving the order of first appearance.

title: Count word occurrences
prompt: Given a list of lowercase words, return a dictionary mapping each word to its count.

title: Find a target pair
prompt: Return the zero-based indices of two distinct list values that add to target, smaller index first. Exactly one pair exists.

title: Longest span without repeats
prompt: Return the length of the longest contiguous substring without repeated characters.

title: Merge overlapping ranges
prompt: Merge [start,end] ranges that overlap or touch, and return the merged ranges ordered by start.

title: Check bracket nesting
prompt: Return whether a string containing only (), [], and {} brackets is correctly nested and closed.

title: Count grid islands
prompt: Count connected groups of '1' cells in a rectangular grid of '0' and '1'. Connections are vertical and horizontal.

title: Fewest coins for an amount
prompt: Given positive coin denominations and a target amount, return the fewest reusable coins needed, or -1 if impossible.
